author: Jon Myers
title: Men's Basketball Holds Open Practice Saturday - NewsBreak
text:
By Jon Myers ,
1 days ago The men’s basketball team announced that it will hold an open practice session this Saturday, offering fans a chance to see the team in action ahead of the season.
The practice is scheduled to take place at the team’s home facility and is open to the public. Details about the start time and duration were not provided in the initial announcement.
This event comes as the team continues to prepare for the upcoming non-conference schedule and conference play. The team recently finalized its coaching staff for the 2026-27 season and participated in various media sessions and exhibitions, according to team sources.
Fans are encouraged to attend and get an early look at the players and coaching staff as they gear up for what promises to be an exciting season. Additional information about the event is expected to be released by the team in the coming days.
